hook_text: The relish is on the burner and three strangers are waiting with clean spoons and a scoring sheet. This is how a camp meal gets judged.
clip_script: Chart up. Hands washed. Water on first, onions chopped while it heats. Fry, press an onion: soft? Tomato in, two minutes. Fish in gently. Salt, spice, simmer ten, handle turned in. Clean spoon, taste once: seasoned? Steaming? Serve: 250 grams of pap, 150 of relish, soft portions kept apart. Now tasters from another team, sheet agreed last week. Flavour: would you want more? Texture: soft onions, fish in chunks, pap stiff for adults, smooth for the little ones. Nutrition is not tasted, it is counted: staple, protein, fat, vegetable, about 650 kilocalories, so add a spoon of oil. Then write six parts: what, results, what worked and why, what failed and why, fixes, lessons. Lumpy pap with a cause and a fix beats smooth pap you cannot explain.
visual_style: Whiteboard pot with onions softening; three diamonds ticked in sequence; a scoring sheet with three rows filling; six numbered boxes for the evaluation.
mood: Warm and exacting, proud of honest results.
pacing: Setup, cook, test, serve, taste, count, write, each a beat.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and evaluate a meal you cook on flavour, texture and nutrition.
